title: Modelling
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 1 Creative Activities; not yet checked by a CBC Creative Activities teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Use clay, plasticine or dough. Wet hands a little. Pinch round and round to keep the walls even.

skills.key_step: The child names items made by pinching, the steps of the pinch method, and modelling materials and tools.

floor.question: Roll this clay into a ball.

steps: Push the thumb into the middle.
Pinch the sides round and round.
contexts: small pots made by local potters
a cup for a play kitchen

board.do: Wait for: push the thumb in.

misconceptions.ask: How do you start a pinch pot?
misconceptions.repair: Push a thumb into a ball and turn it.

misconceptions.ask: How do you pinch the sides of the pot?
misconceptions.repair: Turn the pot a little after every pinch.

misconceptions.ask: Is the board a tool or a material for modelling?
misconceptions.repair: Sort: what becomes the pot (clay) and what helps (board, stick).

misconceptions.ask: What do you add to soil to model with it?
misconceptions.repair: Try to make a ball from dry soil, then from wet soil.

checks.question: Name an item made by pinching.
checks.answer: any of: a small pot, a cup, a bowl
